checks.observation: Each remaining 13-triple link has zero three-covers and twelve four-cover candidates sharing one point, with union size seven. Every actual cover is internal. Removing the common point leaves three pairs per cover on six points; the triple-degree cap gives 3N<=2C(6,2)=30, hence N<=10. The general bridge permits arbitrary exterior completions through the same triple cap. Scripts/results are in checks/round09/methodologist/; this does not independently enumerate all deletion cases.

checks.observation: The transfer uses occupied-neighbour mask inclusion, not merely q_j<=q_i: every counted non-star member covers the required surviving cones. Lexicographically first occupied edges partition nonindependent stars; pruning uses necessary ceilings and leaves recheck total 16 and local constraints. Complete exclusion requires the full profile domain, zero unresolved vectors and unchanged bound inputs; partial runs receive PARTIAL_PASS. All four receipts explicitly retain H27, an actual 16-star and guarded R61. No compiler or full fibre replay was run here.
